disclosed.source: the prose of the filing's main document, read by scripts/lib/bdc-prose.mjs; every figure carries its sentence

assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, our asset coverage ratio was 174% and 211%, respectively.

floatingShare.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, $1.0 billion of par, or 87.5% of our debt portfolio investments bore interest at variable rates, of which approximately 82.0% were based on SOFR and 18.0% were based on Prime.

internallyManaged.sentence: On August 18, 2021, the Company changed its name to "Runway Growth Finance Corp." from "Runway Growth Credit Fund Inc." The Company is an externally managed, non-diversified, closed-end investment company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company ("BDC") under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the "1940 Act").
